samples.description: Compustat North America standard industrial consolidated domestic annual panel for Table 1 rolling fits. Raw support uses availability years 1956–2012 and actual DATADATE 1Apr1955–31Mar2012; the regression handoff contains firm availability-years 1957–2011 with one selected annual record per GVKEY×availability-year, current inputs, exact prior-year inputs for changes, and exact 1–3 availability-year earnings leads. For estimation year T=1969–2012 and horizon h=1–3, eligible base years are T−9−h through T−h and outcomes end no later than availability-year T. Model-specific OLS uses available complete cases; there is no later forecast-evaluation/ICC common-sample restriction. Annual 1/99 winsorization applies to final continuous levels and interactions within base availability-year; only AC and TACC receive the paper's explicit missing-to-zero rule.

assumptions: Compustat North America descriptor filters operationalize the paper's all-firms wording.
FYE availability years implement the April–March rule; latest DATADATE resolves multiple annual rows in one GVKEY availability year.
GBP-primary own-date translation uses daily rates for stock items and EXRAT12M monthly rates for flows; unresolved non-USD conversions remain unavailable.
Final continuous inputs/interactions are winsorized by base availability year; DD and NegE remain binary.
Only missing AC is set to zero; annual fits require native full-rank checks and positive residual degrees of freedom.

limitations: The source states missing AC/TACC are zero but does not discuss FX-only construction gaps. Applying that rule after conversion is best-effort: otherwise eligible unique FX-only zero fills are HVZ 591/560/533 and RI 233/214/208 across horizons 1/2/3, all from prior-period CAD daily-rate gaps. The bounded audit is documented in review.md.
